Lecture Overview:
When should you build a workflow instead of an agent, and which design patterns work best? In this Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents lecture, Michael Ryan covers Anthropic's five workflow patterns, reasoning-and-acting patterns (ReAct, Reflexion, CodeAct, ReWOO), and context-management techniques like event logs, compaction, observation masking, subagents, and skills, ending with a case study of the minimal Pi harness.
Speaker: Michael Ryan
